'''Francis Hallé''' ({{IPA|fr|fʁɑ̃sis ale}}; 15 April 1938 – 31 December 2025) was a French botanist, biologist, illustrator, and academic professor.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Butler |first=Rhett |title=Francis Hallé, the botanist who took a raft into the rainforest canopy |url=https://news.mongabay.com/2026/01/francis-halle-the-botanist-who-took-a-raft-into-the-rainforest-canopy/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260218145146/https://news.mongabay.com/2026/01/francis-halle-the-botanist-who-took-a-raft-into-the-rainforest-canopy/ |archive-date=2026-02-18 |access-date=2026-08-05 |website=news.mongabay.com |language=en-US}}</ref> 

He was a [[Professor Emeritus]] at the [[University of Montpellier]],<ref>{{Cite web
|url=http://web.up.ac.za/pdfs/5602_Celebrated%20tropical%20botanist%20delivers%20last%20Centenary%20lecture.pdf
|title=Celebrated tropical botanist delivers last Centenary lecture
|work=web.up.ac.za/ (University of Pretoria)
|accessdate=16 April 2012
}}{{Dead link|date=December 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> and a specialist on [[tropical rainforest]]s - extensively describing what he described as "tree architecture,"<ref>{{Cite web
|url=http://congress-ise2012.agropolis.fr/ftpheb.agropolis.fr/en/Congress_info/Ceremonial_distinction.html
|title=13th Congress of the International Society of Ethnobiology
|publisher=agropolis.fr
|accessdate=16 April 2012
|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160318093658/http://congress-ise2012.agropolis.fr/ftpheb.agropolis.fr/en/Congress_info/Ceremonial_distinction.html
|archive-date=18 March 2016
|url-status=dead
}}</ref> a body of work illustrating and describing [[plant morphology]]. Hallé conducted extensive field work across Africa, Asia, America, and Oceana.<ref name=":0" /> He is perhaps best known for his observations on the "[[Radeau des cimes]]" ("Raft of the peaks"), where alongside a balloon pilot and an architect he made observation-based illustrations on the ecosystem and structure of the tree canopy in an [[Aerostat|aerostatic balloon]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web
|url=http://www.bluechannel24.com/?p=6250
|title=Botanist raises study for the forest from the air in Chile
|publisher=bluechannel24.com
|accessdate=16 April 2012
|archive-date=4 March 2016
|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304074331/http://www.bluechannel24.com/?p=6250
|url-status=dead
}}</ref> This method allowed him to observe tropical microclimates by non-invasive means.<ref name=":0" />

In 2010, he and [[Luc Jacquet]] started to collaborate for a [[Wild-Touch]] film project, ''La Forêt des pluies'', a documentary about [[Old-growth forest|primary forests]].

Hallé died in 2025, at the age of 87.<ref>[https://www.liberation.fr/environnement/mort-du-biologiste-francis-halle-grand-defenseur-des-forets-primaires-20260102_O7B5O256WFDGXML5OZIE4FJ2DU/ Disparition Mort du biologiste Francis Hallé, grand défenseur des forêts primaires]</ref> 
[[File:Le Radeau des cimes sur la canopée de Guyane.jpg|thumb|The Raft of The Peaks (Radeau des Cimes) on an excursion in Guyane.]]
